formal_statement: have x1 : Fin (7 : ℕ) → Fin (7 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x1 x2 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) => x1 = x2 ∨ x1 = x2 + (1 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = x2 + (3 : Fin (7 : ℕ)); have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => x2.size ≤ (27 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x2.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ (x6 : ℕ) (x7 : ℕ), x4.inputs = [x6, x7] ∧ x6 ≠ x7 ∧ x6 < (14 : ℕ) + x3 ∧ x7 < (14 : ℕ) + x3) ∧ ∀ (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x2.eval (List.ofFn x3) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x4 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (7 : ℕ)), x1 x4 x5 ∧ x3 (Fin.castAdd (7 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true ∧ x3 (Fin.natAdd (7 : ℕ) x5) = Bool.true; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => (List.filter (fun (x4 : ℕ) => Decidable.decide ((14 : ℕ) ≤ x4)) (x3.output :: List.flatMap PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate.inputs x3.gates)).Nodup; ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x5 x6 : Fin (7 : ℕ)), x2 x4 → x1 x5 x6 → (2 : ℕ) ≤ x4.lineDeg (14 : ℕ) {↑x5} → (2 : ℕ) ≤ x4.lineDeg (14 : ℕ) {(7 : ℕ) + ↑x6} → ∃ (x11 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x2 x11 ∧ x3 x11 ∧ (2 : ℕ) ≤ x11.lineDeg (14 : ℕ) {↑x5} ∧ (2 : ℕ) ≤ x11.lineDeg (14 : ℕ) {(7 : ℕ) + ↑x6}
plain_statement: Fano plane (7 point inputs, 7 line inputs). C a circuit of at most 27 AND and OR gates, each reading two different earlier wires, computing the incidence function, with degree at least 2 in the input of a point p and at least 2 in the input of a line l through p. Then some circuit of the same kind, in which no gate's wire is read twice and the output is read by no gate, also has degree at least 2 in p and in l.
title: A step toward: Fano plane: no circuit of at most 27 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
